name: Bungee
rootCause: Bungee, operated by Socket, was exploited on Ethereum Mainnet on 16 January 2024. A newly added bridge route without input validation allowed attackers to drain tokens from wallets with unlimited approvals, resulting in an estimated $3.3M loss. Socket paused operations, deployed a fix, and partially recovered funds. A newly deployed bridge route lacked input validation, enabling attackers to pass arbitrary data which allowed unauthorized transferFrom calls using user-approved tokens.
